# CloudFunctions2Function

`cloudfunctions2.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_cloudfunctions2_function`. A Cloud Run functions (2nd gen) function.

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the cloudfunctions.v2 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/cloudfunctions2/testdata/discokind/CloudFunctions2Function/`.

The API refuses a create without the function's full name in the body
("Error 400: Invalid resource name '' for pattern
projects/*/locations/*/functions/*", the catalog's live run in
hfl-dev-514205, 2026-11-13), though the ID is also the `functionId`
parameter; Terraform sends both. The kind is `nameInBody` in
`hack/discokind/kinds.yaml`, so create sends both, and the fake refuses a
`nameInBody` kind's create without the name.

Live, `setup_test.go` makes each function's source first: a bucket
`${NAME}-source` in us-central1 holding `function.zip` (one Python HTTP
function). Afterwards it deletes the buckets, the copies Cloud Functions
keeps of the source in the project's `gcf-v2-sources-*` bucket, and the
functions' images in the `gcf-artifacts` repository.

Live stays skipped until the project's build service account (the compute
default service account) can build: run `cce-11140351-32bb` (2026-11-14)
had the create accepted with the name in the body, and the build then
failed for a missing permission on the build service account. With
`roles/cloudbuild.builds.builder` granted to it, delete the fixtures'
`live-skip` and run the kind live.
